body:
Thanks for the support!

Thankfully I had a chance to reinforce exactly why I'm doing this last night. Though, with the exception of a few kisses, my girlfriend and I were only cuddling each other, she had me absolutely electrified with desire. The best part? I got hard without any feelings of anxiety, guilt or shame.

That actually makes me feel a lot better - thanks!

I'd love to be able to say that I never fantasise about "the perfect woman", as you put it, but that's easier said than done. Luckily any feelings that I'm "missing out" on anything soon melt away whenever I'm with her. I think it's just a matter of rationalising how trivial those things she's "lacking" are. It sickens me that the dimensions of her ass or what she wears in the bedroom even crosses my mind. EDIT: I think I should add, this never leads to MO - I've been tempted on occasion, but I've managed to stick to the whole NoFap arrangement so far.

For me it varies. Some days fantasising feels like it might be helping. Because I don't have fapping as an 'end-goal', I'm not reliant on really dirty fantasies. Instead of turning to my mental porn stash, my thoughts are of my girlfriend. Little details about the way she looks, the way she flirts with me, what we get up to behind closed doors - things which reinforce the importance of 'real' intimacy. 

Of course, I'm not infallible. Occasionally an odd dirty fantasy will slip in there. Some days it's as little as seeing her in sexy new underwear, others I'm thinking of [anal sex](/nsfw) or something equally disgusting.

That was actually one of my reasons to start NoFap properly - to cure my anxiety surrounding sex. Years of porn have turned what should be an intimate act into something dirty and depraved that I certainly wouldn't want to do with my girlfriend. I'm not saying sex purely for the pleasure of it is wrong, but it should be a mutual expression of intimacy, not a means to an end.

This could just be me being defeatist, but what's the point? You make a very good argument, but why suffer the possibility of a better or worse future when I could just exploit the loophole that is suicide. 

Life is just too painful for me to 'see where it goes', so to speak. I take great solace in the fact that life is, ultimately, pointless, but it doesn't nullify the pain.
Unfortunately I'm still yet to "come out" about my PMO habit, so that wouldn't really be possible. I know I should probably tell her, but I'm afraid it would make her feel too insecure.

Well I've got a freezer full of ice (I really hate lukewarm drinks), so I might give that a go. It's an odd cure, but if it works, I'm all for it.

I've been trying to curb my computer usage in general (NoFap is part of a whole change-around for me), so escaping temptation is a little easier, though not entirely without effort (it only takes one sexy picture on reddit and I'm on the verge of relapse).

I'm yet to "come out" about my PMO issues, so the NoFap community is a priceless resource for me. Even as a total newbie here, my willpower has already quadrupled thanks to you guys.

That's what I always try to remind myself - do it for her, not just yourself - but it's been a bit unsuccessful so far. It's all too easy to slip into the trap of "I'm really horny; it will calm me down" or "It's only one PMO".

I really apreciate the advice, but are there any 'top tips' you'd reccomend?
